create.name: Xavier Dagba
create.bio:
Xavier Dagba is a shadow-work teacher and coach whose work joins Jungian ideas about the shadow with somatic awareness, spiritual practice and coaching. Born in Cameroon, he moved to Canada in 2013 to begin a doctorate in economics, then left the programme a year later after a spiritual awakening that had been growing for some years. The fallout, including estrangement from family and a long spell of feeling lost, became his own first deep encounter with the shadow. After several years in fitness and other ventures that he now sees as detours, he committed fully to integration work in 2018.

His central idea is that the parts of ourselves we hide, including our brightest gifts as well as our pain, hold the energy we need to live and lead from the heart. He calls this hidden brightness the golden shadow. His book Scars of Gold, published by Hay House, sets out his framework for this kind of self-liberation. He teaches recorded and live online workshops and six-week and four-month group immersions, and he runs a monthly membership, The Embodied Light Project. He also offers one-to-one mentoring and hosts the ENHEARTENED podcast, where he talks with teachers and writers about the inner life. He is a father of three.

books.title: Scars of Gold: A Framework for Self-Liberation and Integration
books.author: Xavier Dagba
books.description: Xavier's guide to shadow work as a path to freedom. It shows how hidden and rejected parts of ourselves, including unclaimed gifts, keep us stuck, and offers practices for bringing them back into a whole life.

courses.title: Awaken Your Golden Shadow (recorded workshop)
courses.description: A three-hour immersive online workshop, available as a replay, on finding and reclaiming the creative gifts and brightness you have learned to keep hidden.

courses.title: The Alchemy of Self-Abandonment (recorded workshop)
courses.description: A three-hour online workshop with lifetime replay access, on recognising the ways we abandon ourselves and finding the inner strength to make choices that free us.

courses.title: SEEN: Six-Week Immersion
courses.description: A six-week online group immersion for healers, creatives and leaders, using shadow work to loosen the fears that hold back their voice while they move one long-stalled project forward.

courses.title: The Embodied Light Project (membership)
courses.description: Xavier's online membership community, with a monthly live workshop and deep dive from him, weekly calls and guest-led sessions. For the last ninety days of 2026 it runs a twelve-week self-liberation experiment.

free_resources.title: Shadow Integration Free Mini-Course
free_resources.description: A free video series covering the basics of shadow work and how to start recognising and integrating the parts of yourself you have pushed away. Access is by email sign-up.
